purpose: Determine whether the true public release timestamp of the Q019 bid_to_cover_ratio can be reproduced historically for all fixed Q019 events.
fixed_population: Q019 Treasury 10-Year auction result events, unchanged, 89 events
primary_sources: Official Treasury Auction Results RSS/feed metadata
Official Treasury Auction Results XML/result files when historically reproducible
Official Treasury Auction Results PDFs for event identity/content confirmation

xml_result_method.sequence_range: 1..8 fixed; same existing deterministic candidate bound as the result-PDF lookup
xml_result_method.identity_rule: Require exact CUSIP + AuctionDate match, BidToCoverRatio equality with Q019, and ResultsPDFName matching the XML filename.
xml_result_method.http_archive_metadata: Capture Last-Modified, ETag, Content-MD5, and Content-Length as provenance only. Do not use a generic HTTP Last-Modified value as the official release timestamp.

matching_rule: CUSIP + auction_date must match Q019 and the source must contain the bid_to_cover_ratio or its complete components.
timestamp_rule: Accept only an explicit or deterministically documented official result-publication timestamp. A PDF release date without an intraday timestamp is insufficient.
historical_release_semantics: Treasury auction timeline states that from January 2003 the official release time was the recorded time the results XML was delivered to the FRIT server.
coverage_pass_rule: 89/89 events must have RESULT_TIMESTAMP_VALIDATED; otherwise overall status is DATA_INSUFFICIENT.
pit_rule: Determine whether the result timestamp precedes the first actually usable QXNYS session/action point. For the fixed Q019 contract, an XML release on auction_date with auction_date < record_date proves the release preceded the first XNYS session strictly after record_date. Report PIT status separately from the fixed 89/89 timestamp-coverage pass rule. No forward return or P&L calculation is allowed.
next_step_if_pass: Prepare a separate H2 performance preregistration on a new symbol-disjoint validation universe. Q020 remains immutable and is not reopened.
